projects.title: URL Shortener with Analytics

Implemented secure JWT-based authentication, RESTful APIs, and integrated MySQL with Spring Data JPA for efficient URL storage and management. Built features including click analytics, QR code generation, link expiration, and containerized the application using Docker for simplified deployment.
